correctness.rationale: For a cycle letter a(i)=i+1 and partial successor b_A(i)=i+1 on A, i otherwise, shifts H(A) commute with both, forcing every image to have size at least h=|H|. On cyclic quotient of order m=n/h, B=A/H has trivial stabilizer. For every nonzero directed pair separation d choose u∈B, u+d∉B; applying a^t b decreases d by exactly one, so any pair merges within m(m−1) letters. At most m−1 merge rounds compress quotient to one; lifted image has exactly h states and bound m(m−1)². Primitive binary necklace Möbius inversion supplies N_{n,d}=Σ_{e|n/d}μ(e)2^{n/(de)} and fixed-weight N_{n,d,k}=Σ_{e|gcd(n/d,k/d)}μ(e)binom(n/(de),k/(de)), zero if d∤k. Direct independent reachable-subset BFS verified every 1020 active masks n=2..9, including periodic/all/empty boundary patterns. Infinite result follows from pair-merging proof, not enumeration.
